digest.component_or_area: code-review project criterion deployment and validation
propositions: A live Gerrit probe must validate that the deployed review bot loads the review-phase-boundaries criterion from the repository and executes it end-to-end through the four-pass pipeline in advisory mode without blocking

A positive-control patchset establishing the discovery/evidence refinement must produce no project-attributed finding, confirming the criterion's presence and routing without activating on valid instructions

A predeclared FIRE balanced-corpus control patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria project.review-phase-boundaries, and recorded Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 decision/threshold/posture values from the deployed execution

The final cleaned patchset submitted to main must retain only the valid positive-control refinement, emit no phase-boundary finding, and verify that blocking remains disabled at threshold 0.90 throughout the probe
